cases.name: http-set-boost-accepted
cases.note: The request carries no Content-Type header, which no handler checks (HTTP-06).

cases.name: http-set-boost-round-one-replay-shape
cases.note: The SDK neither tracks nor filters rounds: an early round reaches the store, which answers replays itself.

cases.name: http-set-boost-round-exponent-form
cases.note: Integral claims are judged by value: 1e2 is the round 100.

cases.name: http-set-boost-boost-tiny-positive
cases.note: boost has no floor at 1: any finite value above 0 is valid.

cases.name: http-set-boost-iat-old-accepted
cases.note: Ten days old: the SDK applies no age check to a Booster, since BoostX retries re-send the same token.

cases.name: http-set-boost-extra-claims-ignored
cases.note: Unknown members of the root, the booster and the gid are ignored, whatever their type.

cases.name: http-set-boost-nbf-now-accepted
cases.note: nbf <= now passes, and stays passing as the clock moves on.

cases.name: http-set-boost-key-lookups-delayed
cases.note: Asynchronous lookups that answer late, in either order.

cases.name: http-set-boost-header-extra-members-ignored
cases.note: b64 without crit has no effect; kid and x5u of any type are ignored.

cases.name: http-set-boost-partner-keys-rotation-second-verifies
cases.note: The list holds the current key first; the GID verifies with a later one.

cases.name: http-set-boost-partner-keys-unusable-skipped
cases.note: An unusable key in the list is skipped while a usable one remains.

cases.name: http-set-boost-put-not-allowed
cases.note: The method is checked before the body, so the valid token is never read.

cases.name: http-set-boost-delete-not-allowed
cases.note: The method is checked before the body, so the valid token is never read.

cases.name: http-set-boost-patch-not-allowed
cases.note: The method is checked before the body, so the valid token is never read.

cases.name: http-set-boost-options-not-allowed
cases.note: The method is checked before the body, so the valid token is never read.

cases.name: http-put-over-cap-not-allowed
cases.note: The method check comes before the body is read.

cases.name: http-check-bet-absent-post-not-found
cases.note: /check-bet is served only when the bet store implements the check.

cases.name: http-check-bet-absent-get-not-found
cases.note: The path check runs before the method check: an unserved path is 404 for every method.

cases.name: http-unknown-endpoint-get-not-found
cases.note: Path before method: an unknown path is 404, not 405.

cases.name: http-path-uppercase-not-found
cases.note: The endpoint name is matched case-sensitively.

cases.name: http-path-trailing-slash-not-found
cases.note: A "/" after the endpoint name is not served.

cases.name: http-mount-empty
cases.note: An API URL with no path: the endpoints sit at the root.

cases.name: http-mount-slash-only
cases.note: One trailing "/" is removed from the mount, leaving the empty prefix.

cases.name: http-mount-trailing-slash-trimmed
cases.note: BoostX removes one trailing "/" from the API URL before appending the endpoint, and so does the mount.

cases.name: http-key-store-null-construct
cases.note: No key store: the entry point refuses at construction (a Go constructor panics).

cases.name: http-body-at-cap
cases.note: Valid JSON padded with trailing spaces to exactly 65536 bytes.

cases.name: http-body-over-cap
cases.note: Valid JSON padded with trailing spaces to one byte over the cap.

cases.name: http-body-at-cap-padded-inside
cases.note: Spaces inside the object, before its closing brace.

cases.name: http-body-over-cap-before-unknown-partner
cases.note: Two faults: the body step comes before any key lookup.

cases.name: http-body-not-json
cases.note: A form-encoded body is not JSON.

cases.name: http-body-string
cases.note: The token as a bare JSON string.

cases.name: http-body-trailing-form-feed
cases.note: Form feed is not JSON whitespace.

cases.name: http-body-trailing-nbsp
cases.note: U+00A0 is not JSON whitespace.

cases.name: http-body-bom
cases.note: A UTF-8 byte order mark before valid JSON.

cases.name: http-body-bom-after-whitespace
cases.note: U+FEFF is not JSON whitespace anywhere in the body.

cases.name: http-body-invalid-utf8-byte
cases.note: Invalid UTF-8 in a member the handler does not read is still refused: the bytes are checked before parsing.

cases.name: http-body-encoded-surrogate
cases.note: U+D800 encoded as three bytes is not UTF-8.

cases.name: http-body-invalid-utf8-in-token
cases.note: The body byte check runs before the token is examined.

cases.name: http-body-duplicate-token-last-number
cases.note: A repeated member: the last occurrence is the value, here a number.

cases.name: http-body-null
cases.note: A null body reads as a body with no token.

cases.name: http-body-token-name-uppercase
cases.note: Member names are matched exactly: a case variant is an unknown member, so the token is absent.

cases.name: http-body-token-name-other-endpoint
cases.note: The check-bet member on /set-boost.

cases.name: http-body-duplicate-token-last-null
cases.note: The last occurrence wins, and a later null counts as null.

cases.name: http-body-token-leading-space
cases.note: Tokens are never trimmed. The space makes the header segment non-canonical, and extraction never reads the header, so the key lookups run before the parser refuses it.

cases.name: http-body-token-trailing-newline
cases.note: The newline ends the signature segment, which extraction never reads; the parser refuses it.

cases.name: http-body-ignored-member-nested-64-levels
cases.note: The body nests 64 levels deep: the body object, then 63 arrays in the unknown member x.

cases.name: http-body-unknown-members-ignored
cases.note: Only the endpoint's token member is read; the other endpoints' member names are unknown here.

cases.name: http-body-lone-surrogate-escape-ignored
cases.note: A lone-surrogate escape in an ignored member is valid JSON; the lone-surrogate scan covers the token's own texts, not the body.

cases.name: http-body-case-variant-beside-exact-name
cases.note: Case variants never supply or override the exact member.

cases.name: http-body-non-ascii-utf8
cases.note: Well-formed multi-byte UTF-8 is accepted.

cases.name: http-body-escaped-member-name
cases.note: Names are compared after JSON unescaping: \u004a is J.

cases.name: http-check-bet-body-token-name-camel-case
cases.note: The member is checkbetJWT exactly.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-body-token-absent
cases.note: verifyKeysJwt is not verifyKeysJWT: the token is absent.

cases.name: http-set-boost-exp-now
cases.note: exp <= now is refused, and stays refused as the clock moves on.

cases.name: http-check-bet-extra-claims-ignored
cases.note: A stray booster member on a CheckBet is just an unknown claim.

cases.name: http-set-boost-signed-by-partner-key
cases.note: The JWS must be BoostX's: a token signed with the partner key does not verify.

cases.name: http-set-boost-header-alg-name-case
cases.note: ALG is not alg: the header has no alg member.

cases.name: http-set-boost-header-crit-empty
cases.note: Any crit member is refused, whatever its value.

cases.name: http-set-boost-signature-truncated
cases.note: Two characters fewer: 63 decoded bytes, not 64.

cases.name: http-set-boost-payload-padded
cases.note: Extraction applies the payload format rules before any key lookup.

cases.name: http-set-boost-payload-std-alphabet
cases.note: The runs of ~ and ? make the encoded payload contain "-" and "_" whatever their offset.

cases.name: http-set-boost-gid-lone-surrogate
cases.note: An unpaired surrogate escape makes the token malformed, at extraction already.

cases.name: http-set-boost-gid-signature-std-alphabet
cases.note: The GID signature form is checked by the parser, after the key lookups, not by extraction.

cases.name: http-set-boost-gid-signature-empty
cases.note: An empty signature passes the gid shape check and fails the signature form check.

cases.name: http-set-boost-gid-wrong-partner-key
cases.note: The GID was signed by partner2, and the store lists only partner.

cases.name: http-set-boost-gid-other-ids
cases.note: A valid signature over other ids.

cases.name: http-set-boost-boostx-key-wrong
cases.note: A usable key that does not verify the JWS is a token failure, not a key failure.

cases.name: http-set-boost-partner-not-served
cases.note: The id is written between double quotes; "acme" has nothing to escape.

cases.name: http-set-boost-unknown-partner-escaped-id
cases.note: The id a\u0001"b is not served. How the control character and the quote are escaped inside the quotes is implementation-defined, so only the fixed wording is compared.

cases.name: http-set-boost-boostx-lookup-unknown
cases.note: A store reports an unserved id with the SDK's unknown-partner error.

cases.name: http-set-boost-boostx-role-not-given
cases.note: The store fails the lookup with invalid_public_key, as an in-memory store does for a role it was not given.

cases.name: http-set-boost-both-lookups-fail-boostx-error-decides
cases.note: When both lookups fail, the BoostX key's outcome decides.

cases.name: http-order-claim-fault-before-unknown-partner
cases.note: Extraction runs every claim check before the key store is asked.

cases.name: http-order-claim-fault-before-store-failure
cases.note: A store outage cannot change the answer to a malformed token.

cases.name: http-order-expired-before-unknown-partner
cases.note: exp and nbf are part of the claim step that extraction runs.

cases.name: http-order-header-not-read-before-lookup
cases.note: Extraction never reads the header, so the unknown partner is reported before the alg fault.

cases.name: http-order-gid-signature-form-after-lookup
cases.note: The GID signature form is a parse check, not part of extraction.

cases.name: http-order-unusable-boostx-key-before-bad-signature
cases.note: The parser checks its keys before reading the token.

cases.name: http-order-bad-token-before-store
cases.note: The bet store is called only after everything else passed.

cases.name: http-set-boost-store-rejects-wrapped
cases.note: The round-rejected marker found in the cause chain.

cases.name: http-check-bet-verdict-null
cases.note: A verdict that is not a boolean is never forwarded or coerced. A runner whose store type returns a boolean skips this case.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-accepted
cases.note: The response is signed with the partner private key, iss is the aud the store matched, and the nonce is echoed.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-no-bet-store-use
cases.note: Answering /verify-keys never touches the bet store.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-partner-public-keys-not-needed
cases.note: Only the BoostX public key and the partner private key are looked up.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-signs-with-store-private-key
cases.note: The response is signed with whatever private key the store returns.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-nonce-fraction-zero
cases.note: 5.0 is the nonce 5, judged by value.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-iat-past-inside-window
cases.note: 20 s old, and still inside the 30 s window 5 s later.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-iat-future-edge
cases.note: now + 30 is on the edge and moves inside the window as the clock runs.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-iat-stale
cases.note: The handler always uses the fixed 30 s window; nothing widens it.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-iat-absent
cases.note: An absent iat reads as 0.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-verifykeys-null
cases.note: A null verifyKeys reads as {}.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-iss-absent
cases.note: An absent iss reads as "".

cases.name: http-verify-keys-aud-case-not-served
cases.note: aud is matched byte for byte against the ids the store serves; nothing is signed for ACME.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-boostx-lookup-unknown
cases.note: Text after the reason is free-form diagnostic.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-private-key-lookup-unknown
cases.note: Either lookup reporting an unknown partner gives iss-aud.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-aud-boostx
cases.note: A request addressed to boostx itself.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-aud-absent
cases.note: An absent aud reads as "", refused at extraction.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-verifykeys-string
cases.note: A verifyKeys that is present and not an object.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-payload-padded
cases.note: In the handler a payload fault is shape: the unverified aud extraction decodes the payload first.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-header-null
cases.note: The header is not read at extraction; the parser finds it is not an object.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-token-leading-space
cases.note: The space makes the header segment non-canonical.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-signed-by-partner-key
cases.note: A request must be signed by BoostX.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-token-trailing-newline
cases.note: The newline ends the signature segment.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-boostx-key-unusable
cases.note: A store key that cannot verify is answered 500, never a reason.

want.error: failed to get partner private key
failed to get partner private key

cases.name: http-verify-keys-order-shape-at-extraction-before-signature
cases.note: In the handler, the unverified extraction checks claim types before any lookup or signature check.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-order-unknown-before-signature
cases.note: The key lookup comes before the parse, so an unserved id is reported first.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-order-unknown-before-nonce
cases.note: Extraction never judges the nonce.

cases.name: http-verify-keys-order-signature-before-private-key
cases.note: The partner private key only signs the answer, so it is looked up after the request verifies.

cases.name: http-booster-parse-unusable-boostx-key
cases.note: A key error is reported alone, never inside invalid_booster, which is why handlers answer it 500.

cases.name: http-checkbet-parse-no-usable-partner-key
cases.note: Keys are checked before the token, whose JWS does not verify either.

cases.name: http-verifykeys-reason-unusable-key
cases.note: The reason mapper reports an unusable verification key as signature.

cases.name: http-verifykeys-response-partner-boostx
cases.note: No response may claim to come from boostx.

cases.name: http-verifykeys-response-nonce-zero
cases.note: Signing refuses a nonce outside [1, 2147483647].

cases.name: http-keystore-lookups
cases.note: The list keeps its order, current key first; ids are matched exactly.

cases.name: http-keystore-unusable-key-in-list
cases.note: Registration checks every key it is given.

cases.name: http-keystore-roles-null
cases.note: null leaves a role out: registration succeeds and each lookup fails with its role's error.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-404-empty-body
cases.note: No reason phrase is used, only the status number.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-599-empty-body
cases.note: A status with no standard reason phrase.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-400-error-empty
cases.note: An empty error member falls back.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-500-acceptance-body
cases.note: Only a 2xx can be an acceptance.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-200-error-envelope
cases.note: On a 2xx the error member is not used: anything but the acceptance is unexpected.

cases.name: http-client-error-text-302-redirect
cases.note: A redirect is not followed: it is one more answer that is not an acceptance.

cases.name: http-client-accepted-201
cases.note: Any 2xx with the exact acceptance body.

cases.name: http-client-default-base-url
cases.note: No base URL given: the contract default. The fake transport answers; nothing is sent.
